name: Separator Coefficient Space
definition: For every minimal missing pattern $p$ of a nonempty binary class $C$, choose a positive coefficient row $a_p$ on its support, normalized to sum one. The coefficient space consists of the row families for which every concept $c$ has a full-sign witness $x^c$ satisfying $\sum_i\epsilon_{p,i}a_{p,i}x_i^c<0$ for every $p$. It carries the Euclidean subspace topology inside the product of open row simplices.
codomain: Relatively open semialgebraic spaces, considered up to homeomorphism or homotopy equivalence as stated
normalization: Every row is positive and has coefficient sum one. A full cube has the one-point empty coefficient product; the coefficient space itself may be empty.
comments: Invariant under coordinate permutations and independent bit flips. It depends on the positioned binary-class structure, so no claim of invariance under arbitrary abstract graph isomorphism is made. Its nonemptiness is equivalent to realizable ampleness.
